correctness.rationale: Two exact recurrence-matrix identities Q^6=I (mod 4) and Q^24=I (mod 9) reduce all indices to complete 6- and 24-residue computations. The residue vectors yield v_2(T_n) and v_3(T_n) exactly. Complete additivity of P_b, F_{2n}=F_nL_n, and digit-root congruences give the Smith exclusion in all stated bases. A standalone executable reproduces the complete finite certificates and direct checks, without treating finite simulation alone as a proof.

value.rationale: The recent paper demonstrates a shared Fibonacci/Lucas Smith index and uses the doubling identity for factorization-intensive computations; the new law establishes the natural, unrestricted triple nonexistence boundary independently of any factorization and gives exact local valuations plus an infinite-base generalization. This identifies a structural sieve and clarifies precisely what simultaneous Smith membership cannot imply. It is not represented as a solution to the distinct open two-sequence intersection problem or as a deep general digit-sum theorem.
